headline: Türkiye Plans $100 Billion Investment in Power Grids by 2040
summary: Türkiye's National Energy 2040 strategy envisages about $100 billion in investment for electricity transmission and distribution networks.
why: Large-scale grid infrastructure investments are essential for integrating renewable energy capacity and accommodating rising electrification demand. Turkey's capital expenditure plans affect domestic contractors, equipment suppliers, and utility financing.

impacts.name: Utilities
impacts.why: Massive grid spending supports long-term revenue growth for power infrastructure and equipment providers.
